data.name: No Asteroids
data.detailed_description:
What players say


About the Game



An asteroid of 5,000,000 m³ will hit Earth in 90 days. The government already spent 90 days arguing about who pays. Then one miner came to the tender with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. The vote was unanimous, for the first time in history.

You are that miner. Every day you fly down and dig while your air lasts. Back on the ship you sell the ore and buy bigger tools and guns. A big counter shows how many m³ are left. On the first day it hardly moves. Later your ship fires at the rock while you dig, and the number goes down much faster.

From a pickaxe to a missile swarm


You start with the pickaxe you brought. The last tool is a swarm of small homing missiles. Big pieces break off and float away, and you can ride them.

The ship shoots too


Earth has rockets that are already paid for, but they are aimed at the neighbors. So your ship starts with no guns, and you buy them with the ore money. They fire at the asteroid on their own. The most expensive one shoots a black hole into the rock.

Bring a crew


The contract is for one miner, but the government does not check how many came. Up to 8 players can dig the same asteroid in online co-op. The pay is still zero. The ore money goes into one wallet, and the host decides who can spend it. Anyone who sits in the lander can start a 10-second count, or kick a friend out of the hatch. If you are not in the lander when it leaves the asteroid, you black out and lose your cargo. The campaign is the host's save, and guests keep their own game.

Earth is watching


What you find in the rock goes to the ship's museum, like an empty safe labeled "Asteroid defense budget". From the observation dome you can see Earth through a telescope. A crowd holds KEEP WORKING signs. Bookmakers take bets on you. The government meets on a beach. The plot at the impact point is already sold, and the owners rave about the sky view.

Other clients


After the main contract, other clients send offers. A space hotel wants a duck-shaped asteroid gone, because guests say it keeps staring at them.

Singleplayer, or online co-op for up to 8 players. Alone, the main contract takes about 6 to 9 hours.

data.name: Am I Nima
data.detailed_description:
You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her.

Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.

As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.

However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories. 

When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth? 

The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

data.name: No Body No Problem!
data.detailed_description:
No Body, No Problem is an asymmetrical, physics-based social stealth game for 4 players, packed with laughter as you and your friends attempt to pull off the perfect crime.

A murder has taken place. There is a body that needs to be hidden. The call has been made, and the police are on the way.

Three players control the suspects, while one player takes the role of the police officer responding to the report. The suspects must hide the body, remove the evidence, and leave the scene without raising suspicion. The officer must search every corner, track suspicious behaviour, and find the body that proves the murder.

Time is your greatest enemy. The police could knock on the door at any moment, and one small mistake can bring the entire plan crashing down in seconds.

There Is No Such Thing as a Perfect Crime

Every match unfolds through complete improvisation.

A friend may panic while carrying the body, the wardrobe you chose may not be as safe as you expected, or the tiniest clue left behind may catch the officer’s attention. Plans often fall apart within the first few minutes, forcing you to act entirely under pressure.

That is exactly where the fun begins.

The Cop Is Trying to See Everything

The cop is not only looking for the body.

An open door, a broken object, a freshly cleaned floor, or even strange behaviour from the players can create suspicion. Examine the crime scene carefully, search every room, and turn the suspects’ smallest mistake into an advantage.

A new clue could appear at any second.

Every Location Is a Different Puzzle

No two matches play out the same way.

The crime scene may be a small apartment, a crowded shop, a multi-storey car park, or somewhere completely different. Every map offers its own hiding places, interactive objects, and unexpected opportunities.

A method that works on one map may expose you on another.

Physics-Based Chaos

Almost every object in the game interacts through physics.

While carrying the body, you may knock over furniture, get stuck in narrow corridors, accidentally attract attention, or turn the entire place upside down without meaning to.

Even the best plan can become a hilarious disaster because of a single mistake.

How Much Do You Trust Your Friends?

The suspects must work together.

Good coordination can remove every piece of evidence before the police arrive. But as the pressure rises, panic begins. A friend may make the wrong decision, expose you, or blame everything on you to save themselves.

Every Match Tells a New Story

No two games are ever the same.

Different maps, hiding methods, physics-based interactions, and player decisions ensure that every match creates its own funny, chaotic, and unforgettable story.

One match may end with the perfect crime, while another may fall apart seconds after the police open the door.

Because sometimes it is not the police who ruin the perfect plan...

It is your friends.

No body, no problem.

data.name: Arctic Drive
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Pile your friends into a rusted pickup and drive into a frozen wasteland that wants you dead.

Arctic Drive (or Artic Drive for some) is a first-person co-op survival sim for 1–4 players, where your car is your shelter, your storage and your only way out. Scavenge, craft, repair, and keep the engine alive one more mile.

Just don't let anyone near the handbrake.

Your car is your shelter, your storage and your only way forward. Keep it fuelled, keep it in one piece and keep it on the road of the arctic (artic).

Damage is fully simulated: the chassis bends, parts break off, and one bad corner on the ice can end the whole trip. The cold kills you slowly. The icy road kills your car fast.

Every item in the world is a real physical object. If you can lift it, you can load it. Jerrycans in the trunk, boxes across the back seat, a trailer packed to the brim behind you.

But weight burns fuel faster, and one tight turn can spread the whole haul across the snow.

Nothing out here is junk. Empty boxes, broken parts, scrap metal: recycle it into materials, then craft the upgrades and spare parts that keep you rolling.

Find a working generator with a recycler and crafting bench, and you've found a reason to stop for the night. Hook up a trailer or an RV and turn it into a base on wheels.

Every run generates a new road. Around the next bend there might be a cabin, a gas station with fuel left lying around in jerry cans, or nothing but shelter from a blizzard.

Whiteouts swallow the road, night falls hard, and you're managing hunger, thirst and body temperature the whole way. The weather does not care what your plan was.

Play solo or bring up to 3 friends in online co-op, with voice chat. One drives, one yells the directions, one rides in the back with the cargo. And one was forgotten in the last gas station.

It's all teamwork until someone has a great idea to pull the handbrake at full speed.

  • Procedural Arctic (Artic): a new stretch of frozen wilderness every run

  • Simulated damage: chassis and parts deform on impact

  • Physical everything: if you can lift it, you can load it

  • Mobile bases: convert trailers and RVs into homes on wheels

  • Survival: hunger, thirst and body temperature to manage

  • Weather: blizzards, whiteouts and a full day-night cycle

  • Scenarios or sandbox: chase a goal or just drive

  • Co-op: 1–4 players online, with voice chat

The Arctic (or Artic for some) will not kill you, but your fuel gauge will.

data.name: Dirt Town
data.detailed_description:
In Dirt Town you drive heavy machinery and move dirt. Create roads by felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel, digging ditches. Dig for resources and build a race track for the dirt bike!

Its a sandbox with multiplayer -- earn money by completing missions and harvesting resources, buy better machines -- and reach even further into the territory.

Revolutionary simulation

The whole site is one simulation. Everything you do, stays forever (in your save). You have not felt dirt like this in a game before. The simulation includes:

  • Being able to plow, dig and stack material anywhere on the map, always

  • Different materials, layered on each other. Sand is very different from clay in every way

  • Everything is destructible, some are just very hard

  • Moisture that affects grip and dirt movement

  • Water that flows and rain creating creeks and puddles

  • Rocks and trees interacting with the dirt and vehicles in realistic ways

Gameplay

We launch with a first map focused on mining and extracting resources, with lots of cool side missions. Find your way through the wilderness, break a road for the hauler, find the sources, and start shipping it out. Buy new vehicles and conveyors to make it easier.

Do side missions to spice things up:

  • Build a dirt bike track and race it with your friends

  • Jump the truck down a huge cliff

  • Crush gravel to improve your roads

  • Buy a compactor for even easier transport

  • Drain a swamp to find even more resources

Selection of cool features

  • Auto leveling system with slopes and curves. Set sticks, auto level with the dozer

  • Chains for towing -- multiplayer awesomeness

  • Get out on foot and climb -- both terrain and machines

  • Drill into rocks to hook them

  • Crush trees and brush

  • Attachments with real hooking system

System support

You need a decent computer to always have 60+ fps -- see the system requirements

We support most peripherals from gamepads to joysticks and wheels

Where we are going

We launch with a mining focused map, and are aiming to do a major update for snow shortly after.

data.name: SHRED A BILLION
data.detailed_description:
🍫🍬 Please add the game to your wishlist! 🍬🍫


About the Game

One billion dollars. One shredder. You.

A gigantic bank vault is buried under money up to the ceiling — mountains of bills and bundles. Your job is simple and glorious: dig through all that wealth and feed it to the shredder. Every bill pays out, every upgrade makes you faster, and the mountain keeps shrinking.

Grab, scoop, suck it up

Start with your bare hands: grab bills one by one and carry them to the shredder. Then go bigger: a bucket, a shovel and a powerful vacuum that pulls money in a swirling vortex. When your hands get tired, launch drones — they mine and haul the cash without you.

Upgrades you can't put down

  • Over 100 upgrades for your tools, the shredder and your drones

  • A skill tree with branches for your play style

  • Boosts, relics and golden banknotes for the long run

  • Numbers climb from your first dollars to trillions — and beyond

A secret at the bottom of the vault

The vault goes five levels deep. The deeper you dig, the bigger the bills. Shred every last bill, pick up the golden key and open the massive door at the bottom. What's behind it? Find out for yourself.

Better together

Play solo or invite up to three friends to online co-op. Shared progress, one shared mountain of money, voice and text chat — dig together, argue about who buys the next upgrade, and shred a billion as a team.

Features

  • A cozy first-person incremental game

  • Exactly one billion banknotes in the vault, counted down to the very last one

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players with voice chat

  • Drone automation — up to 16 drones dig and haul the cash on their own

  • Five signature moves: ARMFUL, HEAVE, GROUND POUND, OVERLOAD and RALLY

  • The jetpack lifts you out of any pit

  • Customize your thief and find hats in buried chests

  • A Steam leaderboard for the fastest vault clear, solo and in co-op

  • 100 Steam achievements

  • Fully localized into 30 languages

data.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
data.detailed_description:
When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune. 

For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill.

Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety.

Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time.

Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op.


Carry Her Kindness Into the Wild

The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it is your turn to care for her and to continue the work she can no longer carry alone.

Gather ingredients, brew magical potions, solve environmental puzzles, and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring its harmony and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants.

See the World Through Tiny Eyes

Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain trails and magical forests to tranquil lakes and misty wetlands.

To a mouse, even familiar places become enormous. Everyday objects transform into obstacles, opportunities, and unexpected playgrounds, while hidden paths and story fragments reward those who stop, listen, and look a little closer.

Glide through the air, climb to new heights, experiment with the world around you, and find your own way through an adventure filled with quiet wonder.

Share the Journey 

Some adventures are meant to be shared. Experience the full adventure solo, with a friend in local split-screen, or in online co-op for up to four players.

Work together to explore the landscape, overcome challenges, and discover playful solutions. When you play solo, the Shade System lets you create magical copies of yourself to assist with puzzles and interact with the world, ensuring that every part of the journey remains open to you.

Meet Froggy

Your magical Froggy backpack is more than a useful tool, it is your constant companion on the road ahead.

Use Froggy to leap, swing, glide, gather resources, interact with the environment, and solve puzzles. As your journey continues, you’ll discover new ways for Froggy to help you reach hidden places and navigate a world built for curiosity.

Game Features:

  • Explore & Discover: Traverse an expansive, lovingly crafted region inspired by Northern Sweden, full of magical forests, tranquil lakes, and misty wetlands.

  • Play Your Way: Experience the journey solo, with a friend in local split-screen co-op, or in online co-op for up to four players. However you choose to play, explore freely and progress at your own pace.

  • Creative Puzzle Solving: Use creative thinking, cooperation, and the special properties of your remedies to solve playful challenges woven seamlessly into the world.

  • Relaxed Adventure: Uncover heartfelt stories that invite you to rediscover the joy of exploration in a world built around small moments, kindness, and wonder.

  • Magical Backpack: Use your trusty Froggy backpack to interact with the world, collect resources, and solve puzzles.

  • Living Playground: Step into a world designed for playful exploration, full of interactive objects, winding paths, and challenges that reward curiosity.

  • Realistic Physics: Experiment with objects governed by realistic physics, opening up a whole range of creative new ways to overcome challenges and solve puzzles.

data.name: Dumpster Gang
data.detailed_description:
Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

Live the raccoon dream. Knock over trash cans, steal shiny junk, raid snacks, commit tiny crimes, and unleash your inner menace. 

Sprint, climb walls, crawl through vents, and reach places only a raccoon could. Pick up, throw, steal, or smash nearly everything you find and turn every level into your own chaotic playground. 

Play solo or with friends. Work together to carry heavy loot, solve puzzles, and rescue captured teammates... but things never go according to plan. Betrayals, disasters, and hilarious accidents are all part of the job. 

Cause enough chaos and the Exterminator will hunt you down. Outsmart his traps, escape capture, and rescue your friends before your gang ends up behind bars.  

Return home after every mission to customize your raccoon, unlock hats with unique abilities, and decorate your hideout with every ridiculous item you've stolen.

data.name: Reshine
data.detailed_description:
Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.

Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.


Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

When every part looks like new, you can slowly bring everything back together. Piece by piece, watch the object take shape again. Before you know it, it’s looking like its old self again, or maybe even better.

And that's it! Compare your final result with the object before restoration to see how much it has changed. You can repeat the restoration as many times as you want, to try different colors or just relive the experience. But, most importantly, more old treasures await you!

data.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life
data.detailed_description:
Rekindled is a co-op tavern management game where you run your own tavern in a fantasy-medieval setting. You'll gather ingredients by foraging, fishing and farming, cook them in a variety of cooking stations, and present them how you'd like on plates for your customers. You can use the money earned to expand your tavern, buy more decorations, adopt pets and much more.

Rekindled is different to most cooking games - there's no stress! Customers don't make any demands of you; they simply buy the dishes you craft and arrange yourself.

Exploration

The area around your tavern is rich with resources and secrets, and you're free to explore as much or as little as you'd like.

Decoration

Expand your tavern and unlock, build and purchase a huge variety of furnishings to decorate it with. There is a silly amount of freedom (you can place items on walls and ceilings if you really want to!) so you can truly make the tavern your own.

Cooking

Enjoy total freedom to create the dishes you want to offer! You can make cheese boards, dessert trays, sushi platters and loads more, in any combination your heart desires. Unlock new foods and creation stations to unleash even more creative options. 

Co-op Multiplayer

The game can be played perfectly on your own, and you can also invite an un-capped number of your friends to help out. You share the same unlimited inventory for maximum freedom, and can collaborate or chill out as much as you want.

Seasons and Weather

Enjoy a variety of weather across the four seasons including fog, rain and snow. There's nothing cosier than hunkering down in your tavern during a thunder storm!

Guests will react to the weather as well, so you may want to cover any tables you placed outside!

data.name: HUNGER
data.detailed_description:
JOIN THE COMMUNITY


About the Game

War has ravaged Europe - but something far worse now grips the continent. A Bacterium of unknown origin has twisted the land, leaving behind only ruin, fear, and something far more sinister. In this multiplayer first person extraction RPG, players will scavenge a decaying world, face unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival survivors in desperate, high-risk expeditions where every step could be your last…

At its core, this is a deep, first-person RPG - one where your story unfolds through the high-stakes loop of a multiplayer extraction shooter. Progress from level 1 to 100 by completing quests, surviving Expeditions, and mastering a robust skill system that evolves with your choices. The extraction loop isn’t just a gameplay feature - it’s how you grow stronger, build your reputation, and gain access to advanced weapons, rare gear, bags, armor, cosmetics, ingredients, and other vital resources. Every Expedition shapes your path forward.

Players can also choose a unique crafting or gathering profession, allowing them to create valuable items - whether for personal use, to aid their friends, or to sell within the player-driven marketplace. Crafting adds a layer of economic and strategic depth, rewarding specialization and community interdependence.

Whether you venture alone or in duos or trios, survival demands strategy, nerve, and adaptability. The game features no wipe mechanics typical of the extraction shooter genre, ensuring your progress and story persist. Customize your appearance with cosmetics found as loot in-game, trade in a player-driven marketplace, and connect, quest, and transact with others in the social hub known as the Chateau. Proximity VOIP adds an immersive edge to every encounter - friend, foe, or something in between.

As players progress, the endgame expands the core extraction loop with distinct PvP and PvE experiences - including dungeons, boss encounters, and intense PvP combat - offering ever-evolving challenges for those who survive long enough to face them.

Prepare yourself for a world where death is not the worst fate.

FEATURES

  • Early Access launches with three large and very different maps, with more to come.

  • More than forty weapons on Early Access launch with more to come.

  • Huge variety of gadgets, medicines and tools with more to come.

  • Unique hybrid of shooting and slashing combat.

  • Large variety of customisation, including characters, bags and weapons - the majority of which are acquired for free in-game.

  • Deep and permanent RPG skill progression.

  • Multiplayer hub world - the Chateau - to interact with other players, NPCs, Professions, quest givers and more.

  • Enormous build variety, with many viable playstyles.

  • In-depth questing and storylines.

  • Varied and engaging end-game content, including dungeons and boss encounters.

  • No forced wipes.

  • Proximity VOIP in Expeditions.

  • Gathering and crafting Professions.

  • Player driven marketplace.

FIND YOUR PLACE

In the unforgiving World After the End, your survival and prosperity are intertwined with the denizens of the Chateau - a broad array of quest givers, shopkeepers, stashkeepers, bounty hunters and other Living. Completing quests and building your reputation broadens your access to new locations, abilities, characters, weapons, gear, and vital resources.

INTENSE AND BRUTAL COMBAT

Deliver fire with a rifle or pistol, or lob explosive glass grenades with an experimental hand mortar. When the ammunition runs dry or the gap is closing too fast to reload, draw your axe or mace to enter lethal hand-to-hand combat. HUNGER is built upon a mix of methodical and frenetic ranged and melee combat as you enter a deadly and brutal dance with both the Hunger and other Living who seek to take what is yours. Find and equip armor, bags, trinkets, medicines, weapons, and shields to ready yourself for the different environments and battles ahead.

PROGRESS AND BUILD

While much of your equipment and weaponry may be lost, all experience contributes to progressing your Living and their level. Each of the Living has a set of unlockable unique Passive, Tactical and Ultimate abilities, alongside deep and extremely customisable mastery trees with more than 100 talents to choose from. Build your Living for stealth and solo play by quieting your footsteps and lockpicking doors. Specialise for ranged combat by quickening your reload speed and increasing your weapon control. Sacrifice your lethality and support your party by repairing their armor and healing them. Survival is the only measure of success.

EXPLORE THE PLAGUE-TORN LANDSCAPE

Explore forests, villages, monasteries, citadels, mines and more as you and other Living attempt to explore and plunder the remains of the World After the End.

data.name: Flak Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game

Five players. One gun.

You and your friends operate the feared German 88 mm anti-aircraft gun of the Second World War. Up to five players share one gun: someone watches the bombers and calls out the range, while the others aim, set fuzes or load the next round.

Then comes the first shot. You watch where the shell bursts and adjust. Too short? Too late? With every shot, you get to know the gun a little better. With practice, the next job gets done before anyone has to ask.

Find your place in the crew

Divide the jobs or move between stations when someone needs a hand. At the rangefinder, you track the incoming aircraft. At the aiming wheels, you keep the gun moving with them. Bringing up ammunition means your friends won't be left waiting at an empty breech.

Let one player handle both aiming axes or split elevation and traverse between two people. Keep talking to each other. A range called out in time matters just as much as the next shell being ready.

Get to know the 88

Work the handwheels and breech, carry ammunition from the supply point and prepare each round. Set the fuze so the shell bursts as close to the target as possible.

A burst behind the bomber formation tells you something. So does one that goes off too soon. Watch the result, adjust your fuze setting and lead, then try again. Over time, you'll get a feel for the gun and learn how to put shots on target together.

Keep an eye on the sky

By day, bomber formations cross your field of fire. At night, searchlight beams help you follow the aircraft. Hits can damage engines, tear away parts and bring bombers down.

Between waves, there's time to bring up more ammunition and get ready for the next approach.

Want a gun of your own?

In Arcade mode, each player gets a separate gun. An automatic crew handles range measurements, fuze settings and loading. You choose your targets and aim the gun yourself, playing alone or with up to four other players.

After each round, compare scores and use the experience you've earned to train your crew.

What to expect

  • First-person operation of the German 88 mm anti-aircraft gun.

  • Cooperative play for up to five players on one gun.

  • Manual aiming, rangefinding, fuze setting and loading.

  • Flexible crew roles, with separate or combined aiming controls.

  • Day and night missions against bomber formations.

  • Timed shell bursts and aircraft that show damage and break apart.

  • Solo and multiplayer Arcade mode with automatic crews, individual scores and crew training.

data.name: Lost Bitcoin
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere beneath this gigantic junkyard lies your Bitcoin USB stick. Find the right one among many.

1. Collect and Burn

Pull scrap out, carry it to the furnace and throw it in. Every piece pays coins. The deeper you dig, the more it pays.

2. Buy Upgrades

More than 60 upgrades in a skill tree, and more are planned.

3. Collect More and Burn More

Suck up a whole tank of scrap and shoot it into the furnace. And there are many more ways to farm more efficiently and progress faster.

4. Build a Factory

Up on the deck you build a factory of your own. Cranes lift scrap out, belts and sorting gates send it on, and machines turn it into rubber ducks, piggy banks, arcade machines and little robots. It earns money while you dig.

5. Check USB Sticks and Find Treasures

USB sticks are everywhere, and they all look the same. Only the computer on the platform tells you what is on one. Along the way you find crates, safes, golden pieces and an entire sailing ship buried under the scrap. Cut your way in. Maybe you'll find your Bitcoins and get rich.

6. Wishlist This Game

Wishlist Lost Bitcoin so you don’t miss the release.

data.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
data.detailed_description:
The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real.  Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a PvE survival adventure where you must reunite your gnome companions to survive and thrive together in the Dark Forest. Explore an ancient Nordic wilderness, uncover its mysteries, encounter the Väsen - the mythical beings of Nordic folk belief, and make the forest your home. Play solo or with up to 7 friends in a procedurally grown forest sandbox.

The Dark Forest found you. 

Into the Dark Forest

Step into an ancient forest through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Every tall pine, mossy hill and damp rock is a climb, and every climb is a challenge of its own. Stumble across scattered gnome dwellings, delve into mossy caverns and explore carefully curated biomes teeming with life.

The pressure to survive drives you forward, opening up new possibilities and discoveries as the Dark Forest reveals itself as a living world of mystery, wonder and danger. Cold, hunger and hidden threats push you to adapt. Gather blueberries and twigs, craft everything from arrows to musical instruments. This is a wilderness not just meant to be explored, but a place to understand and ultimately call home.

Live Among the Väsen

The Väsen: Trolls, faeries, sirens and other mythical beings also call the Dark Forest home, each one handcrafted and drawn from the World of Trollheim. Some will wander over and join you by the campfire. Some will attack on sight. Calm their nerves or offer them something in return, and they might even come and live with you.

Make the Forest Your Home

Let creativity shape your dwelling, wherever feels like home. Build idyllic housing in the treetops, within hollowed logs, tucked into rock crevices or by the mist-filled forest lakes. Add bridges, clad your walls in moss and set some low lighting, whether you're blending into nature or standing out as uniquely yours.

Survive and Thrive

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a place to connect with yourself, nature, and each other. It is fully playable solo offline or in co-op with friends, supporting up to 8 players.

For more adventures in the Dark Forest visit our website 

Enter the Dark Forest and the untold tales of Väsen through an interconnected narrative spanning books, collectibles, music, games, and more.

data.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
data.detailed_description:
Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel is the first game in the series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel depicting what happened after the 2014 anime film Expelled from Paradise.

Civilization has been destroyed by the Nano Hazard, a runaway nanomachine disaster, and most of humanity has given up their physical bodies to live on as data in the virtual world of DEVA. Angela Balzac turned her back on that world and chose to live on the surface with her partner, Dingo. Theirs is a story shaped by the conversations they have shared and the choices they have made—and it is your choices that will determine where it leads.

■ The story stirs once more, down on the surface

A.D. 2400. Ever since the Nano Hazard, a catastrophic event that laid waste to the surface world, 98% of humanity has abandoned both the ravaged Earth and their own flesh and blood to migrate to the virtual world of DEVA. Now, a strange new lifeform has suddenly begun sprouting on the surface: the Paraflora. As it spreads at alarming speed, colossal worms have started to appear nearby, attacking people one after another. At the heart of the outbreak lies Svarga, a desert town that was long ago abandoned due to a plague. Meanwhile, an agent of DEVA’s Security Bureau has stolen Grey Goo, a top-secret file holding data on the Nano Hazard, and fled to the surface. Their trail, too, leads to Svarga. And now, in this ghost town shrouded in mystery and conspiracy, several competing agendas are about to converge.

■ With the K2-system, Angela’s heart is in your hands!

In the film, Angela felt the wind on the surface, met Dingo, and changed little by little. This game takes her growth even further, telling a story of Angela that no one has ever seen before.

The K2-system, the choice system at the heart of the game, allows you to follow her emotional journey through the choices you make.

The story has more than one ending. Some paths lead to endings from which there is no turning back.

■ Character

Angela

A former System Security Officer from DEVA. She possesses exceptional potential in cyberwarfare.

Originally an information-based life form with no physical body, she descended to the surface world during a ground mission in a hastily cultivated body equivalent to that of a sixteen-year-old.

Though once regarded as a highly promising Security Officer, she defied senior Security Bureau officials during the Frontier Setter incident and broke away from DEVA. Since her defection, she has been hiding from DEVA's pursuers and living on the surface with Dingo, helping him with his work as a handyman.

Dingo

Zarik Kajiwara, also known as Dingo.

A surface dweller with brownish-black hair and a beard.

He once worked as an Observer, supporting DEVA Security Officers during ground missions. His abilities as an Observer were excellent, earning him an overall S-rank evaluation, though his conduct was also deemed problematic.

During the Frontier Setter incident, he supported Angela and, through his deduction and quick thinking, helped her reach the truth. He has since left his work as a DEVA Observer and now looks after Angela, who has migrated to the surface.

■ Game features

- Multiple endings, including bad endings

- Full voice acting in all major scenes

- TIPS feature for exploring the game’s terminology and world in greater depth

- Read-text skip, backlog, autosave, and more

- Supports both Japanese and English (switchable in-game)

SHARKS UNDERCOVER

You and your friends are sharks masquerading as dolphins to dupe and snatch the clueless fish who wander into your shop. Keep up the act and don't let those teeth show!

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

Stock the shelves with sponges and bottled water, serve the locals, and keep the place spotless. Work your fins off to earn their trust - it’s the perfect cover for your shady business on the ocean floor!

GIVE WHALES A GLOW-UP

Win the trust of the ocean’s behemoths by buffing their bellies and fins until they sparkle. Gaining whale loyalty is your ticket to winning over the smaller fry!

THE PREDATOR'S SECRET KITCHEN

Snatch your own customers and turn them into gourmet delicacies in the hidden basement beneath your shop. Your shop is the bait, and they’re the main course!

THE FISH POLICE ARE WATCHING

Underwater cops are on your tail! Scrub the crime scene, lie through your teeth during interrogations, and don’t let the fuzz catch a whiff of what’s cooking in your kitchen.

data.name: PC Store Together
data.detailed_description:
You and your friends pooled everything you had, signed the lease on an empty unit and hung a sign in the window. Bare shelves, one workbench, just enough cash to fill a single order.

Build it. Fix it. Sell it. Try not to argue over who's stuck on the register.

Every build is done by hand. Mount the CPU, seat the RAM, screw in the motherboard, close the panel and pray it posts.

  • Real part-by-part assembly: CPU, cooler, RAM, GPU, PSU, storage, fans.

  • Compatibility actually matters. Wrong socket, wrong slot, not enough watts, no boot

  • Thermals, wattage and performance are simulated, so a bad build is a bad build

  • Benchmark the finished rig and slap a price tag on it

Customers drag in machines that "just stopped working." No error message. No details. Sometimes no side panel.

  • Test components one at a time to find the faulty part

  • Repair, replace or upgrade, then bill accordingly

  • Deliver a working PC back to a customer who still insists it was fine before

  • Expand the shop, add workbenches, testing stations and display areas

  • Unlock better hardware tiers as your reputation grows

  • Decorate and lay out the store exactly how you want it

  • Turn a one-room repair shop into the biggest hardware store in the city

Full online co-op from the first minute. No solo-only career mode, no unlocking multiplayer later.

  • Play with up to 4 players in the same shop

  • Split the jobs: one on builds, one on repairs, one on the register, one "supervising"

  • Work the same PC together, hand parts back and forth, fix each other's mistakes

  • Online co-op for 1 to 4 players

  • Hands-on, part-by-part PC building

  • Hardware diagnosis and repair jobs

  • Full pricing and inventory control

  • Customer service, checkout and order management

  • Store expansion, layout and decoration

  • Progression through component tiers as your shop grows

data.detailed_description:
C.L.T. brings old-school GTA chaos to Brazil: a single-player, top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and GTA: Chinatown Wars. Steal a car, thread a gap between police cruisers and watch the intersection behind you turn into a pileup. Ditch the smoking wreck, vault a wall and keep the getaway going on foot.

Two playable protagonists, jobs both legal and criminal, and procedurally generated islands give you plenty of reasons to take one more turn. From beachfront streets to dirt roads and gang shootouts, you're free to chase a payday or start trouble just to see how far it goes.

You can see the whole intersection go wrong.

Pick your gap. Cut across traffic. Smash through a fence when the road stops looking like a good idea. The view from above puts your car, the cops and the next opening in the same frame, right as your getaway starts falling apart.

Cars crumple, catch fire and set off chain explosions. Push the wanted system to five stars and face helicopters and the army. Steal a faster ride, escape over the rooftops in a helicopter or get behind the controls of a tank and make the situation considerably worse.

A fresh island means learning the streets all over again.

Generate a world in Random Map mode and head somewhere you haven't been. Follow the coast in a speedboat, take a rural road out of town or fly over the forest to reveal more of the map. New layouts give you new routes to discover before you need them in a getaway.

Choose the size of your island. Keep exploring after dark, when headlights pick out the road and police lights reflect off rain-soaked asphalt.

Your phone has work. Some of it is legal.

Take a food delivery or a passenger across town to earn cash and discover another neighbourhood. Try a shift in an ambulance or a police car. When you want a different kind of payday, the Dark Web puts assassination contracts, suspicious packages and illegal races on your phone.

Need money to enter a race? A loan shark can help. Fail to pay it back and a gang comes to collect. A little extra cash can give you a whole new problem to deal with.

A getaway specialist. A driver who belongs in a faster car.

Play as Jonilson, a Brazilian with a talent for shaking off the police, or Daria, a Russian whose driving gives her a head start behind the wheel. Switch between them and build up two separate lives, each with their own cash, weapons, phone and skills that improve through use.

Trouble looks good on the Brazilian coast.

Beachfront towers cast shadows over black-and-white promenades. Motorcycles weave through town, gangs fight in hillside neighbourhoods and a football match carries on down the road.

Inspired by Santa Catarina in southern Brazil, São Catarino mixes seaside wealth, rural farmland and local satire. You can join that football match. You can also drive a car through a department store's glass entrance and scatter its stock across the floor. There are plenty of ways to spend an afternoon here.

Early Access

Play Random Map mode now, with both protagonists, legal and criminal jobs, escalating police pursuits and free-roaming exploration. The story campaign and handcrafted São Catarino map are in development and are not included in the current version.

Your next getaway car is parked somewhere out there.

data.name: No Mercy
data.detailed_description:
A brutal Bodycam-style first-person shooter about a man forced to return to the violence he swore to leave behind.

A powerful criminal faction launches a full-scale coup. Within hours, the city descends into chaos. Police vanish. Communications go dark. Entire districts fall under the control of heavily armed gangs.

And on the very day the city falls, they take his wife.

Years ago, he swore never to carry a weapon again. No more bloodshed. No more war.

But some promises only last until someone takes away the person you love most.

Now, armed once again, he must fight through gang-controlled streets and fortified strongholds to find his wife and uncover who took her.

This is not a war for the city.

This is his war for her.

BRUTAL BODYCAM FIREFIGHTS

Feel every shot, every impact, and every second of chaos through a raw, immersive bodycam perspective.

CHOOSE YOUR APPROACH

Not every situation should be approached with a direct assault.

Move quietly, observe enemy movements, use the environment, and choose the right moment to strike. Slip past enemies unnoticed, eliminate them one by one, or engage them in open combat.

Every district hides another clue. Every answer brings him closer to his wife—and deeper into the conspiracy behind the city’s collapse.

A CITY BREAKING AROUND YOU

Fight through abandoned streets, residential buildings, dark interiors, and fortified gang hideouts.

Bullets tear through glass, sending shards across the room as seemingly quiet spaces turn into deadly battlefields within seconds. Every shot carries weight, and every firefight leaves its mark on the environment.

IMMERSIVE BODYCAM REALISM

Realistic weapon movement, natural camera motion, and a minimal HUD are designed to pull you directly into the action.

Weapons move naturally with the character’s body, reacting to turns, movement, running, and sudden actions. The camera captures the tension of every step, while the lack of unnecessary interface elements forces you to rely on your own vision, awareness, and reaction time.

You are not watching the fight from a distance.

You are standing inside it.

data.name: Carry On Together
data.detailed_description:
Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players.

Start a small delivery company with your friends, take on moving jobs and try to get every item to its destination in one piece. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?

LIFT TOGETHER

Some items are too heavy to carry alone. Stretch out your arms, sync up with your teammates and lift together with physics-based controls. Couches, fridges, pianos and giant boxes all need teamwork. Watch out for tight corridors, slippery stairs and that one friend who lets go at the worst possible moment.

DRIVE THE TRUCK

Load the delivery truck, pick a driver and hit the road. Enjoy the view on the way, but stay alert: one sharp turn and the whole cargo flies. The road might be the most dangerous part of the job. Do you trust your driver?

EVERY LOCATION IS A NEW DISASTER

From suburban houses with wide gardens to multi-story office buildings, from narrow apartment hallways to mountain dirt roads, every location brings its own kind of chaos. Fit the sofa in the elevator, roll the rock off the road, squeeze the wardrobe through the garden gate.

GROW YOUR COMPANY

Every successful delivery earns money, and every broken item costs you. Upgrade your company, take on bigger jobs and prove you're the best (or worst) movers in town.

data.detailed_description:
When Chests Rain Tons of Loot is an incremental loot game about building an army and grabbing tons of loot.

Drop your heroes anywhere on the field and they fight the slimes on your screen, while you grab the loot they drop. Everything you grab goes into your treasure chest.

The chest bursts

Fill your chest past its marks and it turns Silver, Gold or Diamond for even more gold. When time runs out, it bursts and rains everything back down for one last grab. LOOT IT!

Grow stronger

Spend your gold in a huge skill tree: more heroes, harder landings, more arrows, more gold and better loot. Every run is bigger than the last.

What's in the game

  • Your army: Archers, Thunder Mages and more. Drop them where you want and they fight on their own.

  • The Barbarian: he fires up your heroes with war cries.

  • A huge skill tree full of upgrades for your heroes and your loot.

  • Gear and the forge: equip items and refine them, but the higher you go, the bigger the risk.

  • Cards to collect and slot for big bonuses.

  • New lands and bosses: a new map every run, and a boss waiting in every land.

  • Surprises: Golden Slimes, Slime Rain, the Treasure Goblin.

  • An Adventure Book of every slime, boss and event you meet.

  • And TONS of loot!

Out now! Drop your heroes and let the loot rain begin!

data.name: Arkheron
data.detailed_description:
"Find me next cycle. I will remember you."

— Karriv, the Forge

Craft your hero. Outplay your rivals. Take the Tower.

Arkheron is a fast-paced, team-based PvP game where the items you find give you powerful abilities to master. Combine them to outplay opponents with your skill and creativity, turning impossible fights into unforgettable wins. No two runs will ever be the same. Thousands of item and ability combinations make every fight different and every victory well-earned.

If you've played a shooter or a MOBA, your aim and instincts already work here. The builds, the counters, and the ways a fight can turn all come down to your adaptability, skill, and teamwork.

The Climb

The Tower is caught in an endless cycle of destruction and renewal; your only way out is to keep climbing.

Ascension is the main event. Teams of three enter the Tower to fight monsters, loot powerful items, and battle rival teams for control of Beacons. Fight your way through the Tower as rival teams are eliminated floor by floor, until only two remain for the final showdown at the summit.

Spires is pure 3v3 arena combat. Your team against another, one fight after the next. Choose your build, take down your opponents, and keep climbing. How high can you go?

Creative, High-Skill Combat 

Arkheron's isometric free-aim combat keeps you in control throughout the fight: take advantage of cover and line of sight to set up the perfect shot, dodge and dash to get in close, and pay attention to sound and enemy positioning to predict the danger before it's on top of you.

Combine powerful abilities in unexpected ways, find opportunities your opponents don't see, and pull off plays that showcase your creativity and skill.

The combat plays just as well on controller as it does on mouse and keyboard, so if your friends are on console, you can't blame that for the loss.

The Items Are the Heroes

In Arkheron, you're not playing a hero. You're building one. Every Relic you equip grants powerful abilities that define your playstyle. Mix items from different Eternal sets to create your own combinations, or swap them as you play to adapt your build to the fight ahead.

Collect two Relics from the same Eternal to unlock a set bonus, or gather all four to transform into that Eternal and gain a fight-changing fifth ability. But choose carefully: once you transform, there's no going back.

An Ever-Changing World 

The Tower is a world built from memories, constantly reshaped by the emotions and unfinished histories of the dead. As the stories of the Eternals unfold, the world and the game will continue to evolve.

As new Eternals enter the Tower, their items and abilities can change the way everyone plays. New builds emerge, familiar strategies are challenged, and the competitive meta keeps evolving alongside the world.

See you in the Tower.

data.name: A Sector Darkly
data.detailed_description:
A Sector Darkly is a 2-d real-time space exploration sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, scavenge, research, craft and survive a sector in chaos. Interact and dialogue with more than 10 alien races. Imagine a 4x-LITE universe, where instead of being in command of the faction, you are in command of a single ship and crew just trying to survive. An open world exploration, with an underlying mystery: sectors are going dark one by one and no one knows why.

Take command of your ship and crew, survive, solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

FEATURES

  • The simulation manages all entities and actors in a fully simulated universe. Miners pull ore from asteroid belts, and move it to refineries. Traders move goods and those raw ores locally to star ports and industrial stations for processing. Haulers and freighters move goods large-scale across the entire sector. The military patrols and protects from hostile forces and invading U'Guul.

  • Engage in fierce combat against hulking dreadnoughts, battlecruisers, destroyers and phantom fighters. Use point defense, powerful devices, special weapons, missiles, torpedoes, and mines to defend your ship and others.

  • Mine, scavenge, salvage, pillage, protect the vital trade lanes, conduct missions to gain favor and research assistance... the choice is yours: follow the laws of the region or take what you want by force.

  • Ship classes exist, but are not made obsolete when you upgrade or purchase different ships. Ships have role bonuses and a unique special device/weapon per class. There is no better or best weapon or ship. Instead of upgrades, think of them as side-grades. Some things might be flexible, but generally not as good as a specialist item. Dozens of ship components enables hundreds of combinations to suit your fighting style.

  • Radar cross-section, heat and EM signatures play a role in detecting entities. The more powerful these signatures are the farther out you can detect them. Your own heat/cross-section plays a role in how far you can be detected.

  • This enables stealth gameplay mechanics: equip a heat-sink and lower your heat signature to mask your signature for a limited time (but get too close and you will be detected!) at some point you have to vent your heat!

  • Each with their own distinct manner of communication.

  • From the enigmatic Coriantans to the aggressive V'Throni and the unstoppable U'Guul. The passive Noxu, the depressed Boolooloo & more. Maintain cordial relations and they will assist you. Under attack? Send a distress call. Damaged? Ask for repairs. Disabled? Request a tow.

  • Stable, Unstable, Ancient wormholes and sectors to be discovered and exploited. Unstable wormholes can be stabilised with the right technology, unlocking new sectors to exploit or new shortcuts across the sector.

  • Stabilise wormholes before entry. Some wormholes can only be traversed by smaller support craft. Park your mothership, launch your runabout, go exploring and come back right where you left it, even if you leave the system!

  • Your crew offers passive bonuses to various stats. They consume water and food (which you can craft from raw materials gathered while on long expeditions). You can send them on away missions to planets in a shuttle to gather materials for crafting. All in real-time, no abstraction.

Support Ships

  • In addition to your pilot-able support craft, you can equip yourself with a suite of drones for mining, salvaging and repairing. Deploy them and continue exploring, they will return on completion.

  • These phenomena can lead to dark sectors, where the only light you have is what you bring with you. There are things in the darkness which don't like the light.

data.name: GrimKeep
data.detailed_description:
GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

Big Damage Isn't Rolled. It's Built.

  • Find items and try out different combinations for maximum damage.

  • Roll the dice for powerful combos that fire off your items’ bonuses and multipliers.

  • Tune your bag by acquiring dice with special abilities such as poison, healing or gold.

  • Further enhance your build at the Crucible. Melt items and their abilities into something new.

  • Outsmart the enemies by tactically using your defense, stuns, and heals. Your strategy determines how far you will make it.

  • Use what you learned to optimize your next run, or try a totally different build.

A Rotten Nightmare Fairytale

The city is cursed and you must do what you can to set things right.

  • Choose your path on the map and assess the risks and rewards at every crossroads.

  • You are the hero of this fairytale. Play as The Huntress or The Beast and unlock more characters as you progress. Each with unique strengths to build and tune around.

  • Take a chance at encounters with curious strangers in the city. You may or may not regret it.

What’s In the Game

  • 200+ items with endless combinations

  • 60+ unique monsters

  • 7 playable heroes

  • 7 dice types

  • 30 hero skills to unlock

Made With Love

GrimKeep is made by a small dev team and we’re pouring our hearts into this game! We love to share our (sometimes chaotic) journey with you and always appreciate hearing what you think.

data.name: Defilade
data.detailed_description:
SOLDIERS THAT THINK & PLAN

The soldiers think a lot and i mean a lot! Almost every single object, vehicle even trees standing or blown off, gets used as cover. They heal, plan rescues, execute deep trench warfare, garrison buildings and roof tops, fight in tunnel systems and medic teams even use stretchers to pick wounded up from the battlefield. When one of the medics gets killed the other medic will put down he's stretcher and drag the soldier.



When a soldier gets shot in a failed rescue attempt, another soldier will try to throw a rope at him to pull him to safety.

Soldiers have multiple different real world Drill simulation tactics coded into them, when it's on auto they will choose the most appropriate drill for the situation on hand and execute it automatically. 

The frontlines mode features a massive large scale conflict mode where you can see the front change in real time.

Building complex trench systems anyway you want! With additional defenses like: Mines, Barbwire, Tank traps, Machine gun nests, tank trenches, trench bunkers, netting to protect from FPV drone strikes.


The Rebel faction is a bit like a wild card, they have a lot of improvised weaponry which you could find in real life situations as well. They can dig advance tunnel networks and conduct guerrilla warfare on their opponents. They can plant IED's, they have land drones that explode, you can even stack RPG' units and Anti Air units on any vehicle and they will shoot at everything! 

Multiplayer matches are underway and it is the most fun!

data.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
data.detailed_description:
◆ Story

“When Failed Creations with the same name meet, they have to kill each other.”

This is the Remnant World, a place where Failed Creations from abandoned stories are gathered.

Failed Creations who share the same name must kill one another, and only the last one left alive can become the “real” one.

In this world governed by that cruel rule, an amnesiac Sensei awakens.

There, Sensei encounters three Alices, each a Failed Creation of Alice in Wonderland.

The three of them are likewise destined to kill one another in order to become the “real” Alice.

However, their encounter with Sensei sends that destiny wildly off course.

This is a retold tale of three Alices and an amnesiac Sensei setting out on a journey together...

■ Characters

・Prima, the red Alice

VA: Aoi Yuki

A Failed Creation of Alice.

Clad in a red dress and armed with a single blade, she acts on impulse and instinct.

Reckless and prone to acting before she speaks, she nevertheless cares deeply for her companions. Her trust in and attachment to Sensei are especially strong.

Though she occasionally displays a dangerously possessive side, a little praise is all it takes to cheer her up. She is a pure-hearted and straightforward Alice.

・Secunda, the Alice with the bow

VA: Chiwa Saito

A Failed Creation of Alice.

A calm and collected archer who excels at ranged attacks, reconnaissance, and assassination.

Though sharp-tongued and aloof, she is attentive to the needs of others. She recognizes Sensei’s abilities as a strategist and offers her cooperation.

She is not very good at hiding her embarrassment, making the sincere side she occasionally reveals all the more memorable.

・Tertia, the Alice with the hat

VA: Misato Fukuen

A Failed Creation of Alice.

A white-hatted sorcerer who wields magic.

Though timid and somewhat clumsy, she has the determination to make the decisive move when it matters most. More than anyone, she wants to place her trust in Sensei.

She is a kindhearted Alice who turns each small act of courage into a great victory.

・Alter Alice

VA: Inori Minase

A Failed Creation who closely resembles the “real Alice.”

She possesses overwhelming power, yet shows a puzzling kindness and hesitation only in Sensei’s presence, revealing two starkly different sides to her character.

As the embodiment of both the desire to become “real” and the laws governing this world, she is an unavoidable rival.

・Sensei
VA: Mariya Ise

The protagonist of this story.

Having lost all memories, Sensei sets out on a journey with the Alices.

■ Game Features

・Game Type:

A single-player visual novel centered on experiencing its story.

・Gameplay:

Choices will appear at key moments in the story. Your decisions will determine how the story ends.

・Convenience Features:

Includes skip-read-text, backlog, auto mode, and fast-forward functions.

・Save/Load:

Save and load your progress at any point.

・Gallery:

View unlocked event illustrations and CGs at any time.

Note: Save data from the demo cannot be transferred to the full version.

data.name: Blind Descent
data.detailed_description:
Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure that delves into the unknown realms of the Martian depths. A team of up to four pioneers has been sent for a reconnaissance mission, but what was supposed to be a routine expedition has become a fight for human survival. As exploration begins, the subterranean world reveals itself as a living, reactive ecosystem. What follows is a journey deep beneath the Martian surface, where survival hinges on your ability to learn, adapt, and symbiotize.

1. You are an outsider in a mesmerizing and deadly world: Conduct reconnaissance and find clues about the missing pioneer team as you delve into the Martian depths. With the help of your AI assistant, explore a living ecosystem that challenges you to grow into it, adapt, and ultimately understand its intricate balance. Every step you take reveals more alien secrets, leaving you with a choice: use science to enhance your adaptability and stay human, or embrace an ever more symbiotic existence.

2. Use versatile crafting techniques to survive: Scan and study the lifeforms around you to gather resources and craft essential tools. Observing how alien creatures interact with their environment can lead to powerful insights. Every crafted item connects you further to the rich, biodiverse alien world, transforming survival into a path towards integration.

3. Build a reliable shelter as a basis for exploration: Along your journey into the Martian depths, you will discover the lost team's abandoned base. Clear it, make it yours, and improve it to protect yourself from the planet's many hazards and lifeforms. But beware: vines, fungal growths, and creeping alien organisms are quick to react to neglect and will soon overtake any poorly maintained structures. Your base acts as your starting point for both exploration and learning to coexist with an ecosystem that has its own will.

4. Adapt to alien and unusual environmental hazards and biomes: Face ever-changing threats like underground storms, toxic gases, and aggressive creatures. Success depends on observing and learning. Sometimes symbiosis means turning these hazards into survival strategies.

5. Choose your path to adaptation: You are an explorer, and it is up to you to decide how best to survive in an unknown alien environment. Take a scientific approach by crafting tools and equipment that help you and your team endure while preserving your humanity; or become part of the ecosystem by undergoing mutations that enhance your abilities and open up an entirely different way of existing in this world. Science or symbiosis—the choice is yours.

6. Survive as a team: Collaborate with up to three pioneers to gather resources, build shelters, and explore the underground world together. Symbiosis extends to teamwork—your survival depends on the collective adaptation and shared insights of your crew.

The discovery of this Martian underground world presents both an unprecedented opportunity for exploration and a significant challenge. The successful completion of this mission will not only uncover the fate of the missing pioneer team but also pave the way for future expeditions into this hidden Martian realm. Adapt through either scientific or biological means to survive.

Observing how alien creatures interact with their environment can lead to powerful insights. Every crafted item connects you further to the rich, biodiverse alien world, transforming survival into a path towards integration.

3. Build a reliable shelter as a basis for exploration: Along your journey into the Martian depths, you will discover the lost team's abandoned base. Clear it, make it yours, and improve it to protect yourself from the planet's many hazards and lifeforms. But beware: vines, fungal growths, and creeping alien organisms are quick to react to neglect and will soon overtake any poorly maintained structures. Your base acts as your starting point for both exploration and learning to coexist with an ecosystem that has its own will.

4. Adapt to alien and unusual environmental hazards and biomes: Face ever-changing threats like underground storms, toxic gases, and aggressive creatures. Success depends on observing and learning. Sometimes symbiosis means turning these hazards into survival strategies.

5. Choose your path to adaptation: You are an explorer, and it is up to you to decide how best to survive in an unknown alien environment. Take a scientific approach by crafting tools and equipment that help you and your team endure while preserving your humanity; or become part of the ecosystem by undergoing mutations that enhance your abilities and open up an entirely different way of existing in this world. Science or symbiosis—the choice is yours.

6. Survive as a team: Collaborate with up to three pioneers to gather resources, build shelters, and explore the underground world together. Symbiosis extends to teamwork—your survival depends on the collective adaptation and shared insights of your crew.

The discovery of this Martian underground world presents both an unprecedented opportunity for exploration and a significant challenge. The successful completion of this mission will not only uncover the fate of the missing pioneer team but also pave the way for future expeditions into this hidden Martian realm. Adapt through either scientific or biological means to survive.

data.name: Dear Passengers
data.detailed_description:
WORLD’S WORST AIRLINE IS HIRING!

You and your friends are the crew. Your job is to deliver passengers and cargo to their destination. Preferably in one piece. While one of you pilots the plane, the others keep the cabin together, serve the passengers, and deal with whatever goes wrong before it gets much worse.

WELCOME TO BUDGET PREMIUM!

Passengers expect food, drinks, and a smooth flight. Try to provide at least two of those.

MORE TROUBLE, MORE MONEY!

Before takeoff, choose which passengers and cargo to bring onboard. The bigger the payout, the more trouble it usually causes. Some cargo is hard to handle, some passengers are hard to please, and some flights start going wrong before you even leave the ground.

SAFETY IS OUR TOP-3 PRIORITY!

Trouble can start anywhere onboard. Keep the passengers under control, protect the cargo, and do whatever it takes to stop one problem from turning into a full-blown disaster. Not every solution is elegant, and not every passenger stays onboard.

ROUGH AIR AHEAD!

Weather can turn a normal flight into a disaster. Turbulence and air pockets throw passengers, luggage, and anything else that is loose around the cabin. One bad turn can send the whole plane into chaos.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online co-op with friends

  • Pilot the plane or work inside the cabin

  • Physics-based passengers, cargo, and cabin chaos

  • Dynamic weather, turbulence, and air pockets

  • Risky passengers and high-paying cargo
